taxes.statute: CLEISS 'Les cotisations au Gabon', table 'Taux de cotisation au 1er janvier 2023' as shown on 6 May 2025 (Wayback 20250506125305, R4/fetch/p16/cleiss_gabon_wb20250506.html); the 2026 page (R4/fetch/cleiss11/gabon.html, 'au 1er janvier 2026': family 5 %, work accidents 2 %, pensions 11 %) gives the reform decree's rates from 1 January 2026, not applied to 2025; CNSS decrees not read
unsupported: rates of the 2026 reform (from 1 January 2026) not applied

taxes.tax: Taxe sur les véhicules de luxe (passenger cars above 10 CV: 20 000 or 30 000 FCFA per CV above 10, by age)
taxes.statute: CGI 2025 (DGI Gabon edition), Livre des taxes diverses, 3.1 Taxe sur les véhicules de luxe, art. 5-11 (LFR 2018), world/B08-central-africa-fr/ga/law/cgi2025.txt l. 13711-13745; the 2025 edition holds the LFR 2018 text unchanged. Liability: the owner (art. 6), collected by insurers with the policy (art. 9-10)
unsupported: the tax is collected by insurers with each policy (art. 9-10): modelled as one annual amount, not pro rata
age = 2025 - year of first registration; a vehicle exactly 5 years old is taken as 'de plus de 5 ans' (the text leaves the boundary open)
a car without fiscalHp, firstRegYear or fuel: grade C line
utility vehicles (exempt) and other kinds: no charge
no other national annual vehicle tax in the CGI 2025 (the taxe sur les immatriculations personnalisées, 3.2, is an optional plate charge)
